h: Shabbos Restores the Sanctuary and the Hope of Redemption

p: and afterward the sale of fields and houses,
and the sale of a Hebrew servant
to a Jew, to a stranger, and to an idol's offshoot;
And this verse was already written in its exact wording
And as for the exposition of the Toras Kohanim,
"corresponding to this one who is sold to a gentile,
expounded the order of the passages
about one suspected regarding the seventh year,
and so it is in the Gemara (Kiddushin 20a):
the 'dust' of the seventh year, etc."
he expounded the order of the passages
"Therefore the Holy One, blessed be He,
at the end of all these passages:
If you wish that they not be exiled,
this is what He said at the end of the passages:
which needs guarding all Shabbos long,
the melachah of selecting and the like;
and when he does not go out to his field,
from transgressing the resting of the land.
וְכִי תַשִּׂיג יַד גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב וְגוֹ׳
"And if a stranger or sojourner becomes wealthy, etc.,"
which is expounded about the four kingdoms;
and when they are in exile,
and no longer have the mitzvah of Shemittah
For the whole essence of the mitzvah of Shemittah
that "the earth is Hashem's, and its fullness"
and through this they can repair
and in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah, end of 25)
and in the Pesikta it says
that through one Shabbos properly kept,
for the main thing is that there be
And He said, "and revere My Sanctuary";
and the Ramban, of blessed memory, explains
שֶׁהוּא קָאֵי גַּם כֵּן עַל שַׁבָּת
that it too refers to Shabbos,
and He commanded regarding it both keeping and reverence,
And this is explained in the holy Zohar
and this is the lower Shabbos, etc.;
this is the Shabbos of Shabbos eve,
and yirah dwells in her, etc."
like the words of the Ramban, of blessed memory,
though in his days there had not yet been revealed
And this is that Yisrael on Shabbos
is like the Mikdash in space
And just as in the Mikdash
has fear and awe fall upon him,
this is the revelation of the Shechinah."
in the courtyards of our God
they are called "children of the King's palace,"
as stated in the holy Zohar
(חֵלֶק ב פח, עַמּוּד ב, רנב, ב)
"In the courtyards of our God they will flourish":
which is at the very onset of Shabbos,
And as stated in the holy Zohar
'And she stood in the courtyard of the king's house,
is the Holy One, blessed be He."
And this is as stated in the Midrash
'the courtyards of the house of Hashem.'"
And the courtyards are the Azaros,
that she succeed in her actions
and this is "And she stood, etc."
when they keep the three meals,
they are "planted in the house of Hashem,"
which is the revelation of Atika,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם קכא, א)
as stated in the holy Zohar (II 121a).
that is at the onset of Shabbos
is also "in the courtyards of our God":
for as soon as one accepts upon himself
Yisrael are called "those who fear My Name"
and "the awe of Shabbos is upon the unlearned"
And regarding Shabbos it is expounded
in the holy Zohar and Tikkunei Zohar (Tikkun 48):
that he makes them a dwelling
in the two chambers of the heart,"
dwells within the Children of Yisrael.
"For there are two chambers in the heart;
if they are of the masters of Torah,
they are called houses of walled cities,
as is said of the Exodus from Egypt (Shemos 14:22):
'and the water was a wall for them, etc.'"
and so it is expounded in the Gemara (Pesachim 87a):
who are not masters of Torah,
are called houses of the open villages."
For those who toil in Torah
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא צַו כט, ב)
and they are always in the house of Hashem,
and even one who is not a talmid chacham,
is "in the courtyards of the house of Hashem,"
for "the awe of Shabbos is upon the unlearned."
all Yisrael are like talmidei chachamim,
"'You who sit in the gardens' (Shir HaShirim 8:13), etc.:
on the day of Shabbos they rise early
and come to the beis knesses
and all Yisrael are then called
